events.title: DEMO UPDATE for the Steam NEXT FEST OCTOBER 2026!
events.summary: Hi!Thanks to your feedback, we've made a number of improvements and quality-of-life changes to the Steal & Sell Simulator Demo! We've been listening to your suggestions and working on making the experience even better.Our demo is participating in Steam Next Fest – October 2026, and we'd love to hear what you think about the latest changes!🚐 Van ImprovementsPlacing items in the van's cargo area now requires just one click.You can now interact with the van's doors while holding an item.⚙️ UI & Qua

events.title: DEMO HOTFIX 15.10.2026
events.summary: Hi!We're sending over a hotfix for our demo.We fixed an issue where text wasn't displaying in certain languages due to a font problem.Thanks for reporting the issue and for your feedback!DreamWay Games Team

events.title: Steal & Sell Simulator - DEMO is RELEASED!
events.summary: Hi! We're launching our demo! You can play it NOW!We've improved a few things that you reported during the playtests. Moreover, our demo will be part of the Steam Next Fest: October 2026! So, play and let us know what you think!We're looking forward to your feedback!DreamWay Games Team

events.title: Steal & Sell Simulator - demo PLAYTESTS are CLOSED!
events.summary: Hi! As we announced, we’re closing our short playtests.We’d like to thank everyone who played and left us their valuable feedback — we’re analyzing it right now. Many changes will be implemented (and some already are!).Our demo release is coming very soon (really soon!), so stay tuned ːsteamhappyːDreamWay Games Team

events.title: Steal & Sell Simulator - demo PLAYTESTS are OPEN NOW!
events.summary: Hi! Playtests of the demo of Steal & Sell Simulator are... OPEN!Everyone is getting access - so if you didn't sign up before, you can still join 🙂 The playtests will last until Monday. So it's worth hurrying 🙂 You are allowed to stream! Why so short? We want to collect your feedback as quickly as possible and know what to improve and which direction to take in development. DreamWay Games Team

events.title: SIGN UP for the demo PLAYTESTS!
events.summary: Hi! We have some great news for you! You can sign up for the playtests of the demo of Steal & Sell Simulator!How can you get access to the playtests? It's very easy. You just need to go to our store page and click on the 'Request access' button. It couldn't be easier! When will you be notified about the start of the playtests?Once registration closes, you will receive an email invitation to the playtests. Check it regularly! We can say that you will be able to play... really soon!DreamWay Games
